curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How do three brothers copying cassettes in Naples manage to build one of the biggest pirate record empires in the country?
curatedMovie.description: In 1980s Naples, three brothers turn cassette dubbing into an underground music empire, building an audacious piracy business from the ground up.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Brisk, playful, and music-minded, with a rise-and-fall arc that keeps the energy grounded in 1980s Naples.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: A comedy-history-music mix gives this rise-and-fall story a lively frame for viewers drawn to 1980s Naples.
